shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底童裤主图
一秒传达轻薄透气不闷热的夏季核心利益
放大普通厚硬长裤闷热拘束的痛点，引出轻薄舒适方案
微距证明松紧腰头弹性与细密车缝，穿脱方便
以身高段参考与量线消除选码疑虑，数值留空后期合成
代入春夏户外活动的真实穿着场景，传达活动自如
特写裤脚卷边与均匀走线，证明做工扎实
以整洁折叠与活动黄收口促单，引导下单

style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF packshots, warm off-white #F7F6F2 info panels, deep denim indigo #2B3F63 accent panels, soft outdoor daylight for scene shots
style.iconSystem: simple flat star and dot accents in #FFD400, sparse and playful, never covering the product
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio light with front-left key, soft contact shadows, gentle and airy mood, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent playful clean kids fashion visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of denim indigo #2B3F63, warm off-white #F7F6F2, sunny yellow accent #FFD400 and charcoal text #33383D; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; rounded modern sans-serif; sparse playful flat accent shapes in #FFD400; clean childrenswear photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no recognizable child face.
noDrift: no adult model or recognizable child face
style.presentationRules: stable straight-on eye-level and slight 3/4 hero angles, pants always shown uncuffed-to-cuffed hem clearly, stable scale across the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte light-grey fabric-friendly board #E9E7E2 and clean flat surfaces, natural wood or playground ground for scenes
style.typography: rounded modern sans-serif, clean and child-friendly
